attributes.name: SDLC ingest stalled (no documents written)

esqlQuery.esql: FROM vp-ingest-freshness | WHERE last_write < NOW() - 6 hours | KEEP source, last_write, doc_count_total | SORT last_write ASC

attributes.description: Fires when a sync source has written no documents for over 6 hours. Complements sdlc-sync-health: that rule keys off workflow EXIT STATUS, so a workflow that reports completed while writing zero documents is invisible to it. Two real defects (org-members scope error, project-items bulk interpolation) failed exactly that way. This rule asserts document movement instead. Requires the ingest_freshness transform. NOTE: the 24h timeField window means a source stalled longer than 24h ages out of the window; treat prolonged silence plus rule recovery as suspicious.
